title: API: for each role the status, untracked-create and tracking-flip answers all match the delete answer
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logins: (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager; (b) custom role "QA PL Create&Edit" (Part Library & Inventory View + Create & Edit, Delete unticked); (c) custom role "QA PL View only"; each in its own browser profile with DevTools Network open. Request bodies captured as (a) from the screen: the create body from New Inventory Part and the change body from saving QAPL-T5 unchanged; for (c), which has no edit controls, send them from DevTools in (c)'s own session. Calls per login: (1) POST /api/inventory/parts/create with "isTracked":false and Part Number "QA-S8-AGR-{login}-{run}"; (2) POST /api/inventory/parts/change on QAPL-T5 with "isTracked":false, then again with "isTracked":true; (3) PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<the part created in (1), or QAPL-T5's id for (c)>"],"status":"inactive"}; (4) POST /api/inventory/parts/delete {"id":"<unknown uuid>"}. D14 (by design, SV-11958 not a defect): a Create & Edit role without Delete is hidden/disabled in the UI but accepted by the API for status changes, tracking flips, untracked creates and the delete guard; only View only gets 403.
custom_steps:
1. As (a), send calls 1 to 4 and record each status code.
  2. As (b), send calls 1 to 4 and record each status code.
  3. As (c), send calls 1 to 4 and record each status code.
  4. Compare the four answers in each login's row.
  5. Cleanup as (a): confirm QAPL-T5 shows "{n} available"; open QA-S8-AGR-a-{run} and QA-S8-AGR-b-{run} on the Inactive tab and click Delete Part.
custom_expected:
1. Create 201, both flips 201, status PATCH 200, delete 400 (guard passed, unknown id): all non-403.
  2. Create 201, both flips 201, status PATCH 200, delete 400 (guard passed): all non-403, by design (D14).
  3. All four answers are 403; nothing is created, flipped or deactivated.
  4. Every row is uniform: (a) and (b) all non-403, (c) all 403; no login gets a mixed row.
  5. QAPL-T5 is tracked as before; both created parts are deleted.
